items.reason: The PR creates events for multiple destination calendars in packages/core/EventManager.ts:338-377, but merge cleanup still selects just one old reference and deletes only its event at lines 553-563. Collective booking merges reach this branch through packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1483-1486, leaving the other hosts’ old events behind. This affects rescheduling into an existing booking; ordinary rescheduling updates all references.
